preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**9 for N in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each test case N is between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, str) for line in output)
postconditions.description: Each output line is a string.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(line) < 1000000007 for line in output)
postconditions.description: Each output value is a non-negative integer less than 1000000007.
